title: Approved analytical methods for DBP, disinfectant residual and precursor monitoring, laboratory certification and minimum reporting levels

conditions: Every system monitoring under subpart L, subpart U or subpart V (141.131(a)(1)); subpart L reaches community and nontransient noncommunity systems that add a chemical disinfectant, and transient noncommunity systems that use chlorine dioxide, for the chlorine dioxide MRDL (141.130(a)(2))

claims.subject: Analytical methods systems may use for DBP, residual and precursor compliance monitoring
claims.value: Only the methods specified in 141.131, or their equivalent as approved by EPA, to demonstrate compliance with subpart L and with subparts U and V

conditions: Every system monitoring under subpart L, subpart U or subpart V (141.131(a)(1)); subpart L reaches community and nontransient noncommunity systems that add a chemical disinfectant, and transient noncommunity systems that use chlorine dioxide, for the chlorine dioxide MRDL (141.130(a)(2))

claims.subject: Approved methods for TTHM compliance monitoring
claims.value: EPA Method 502.2 (purge and trap, gas chromatography with electrolytic conductivity and photoionization detectors; the photoionization detector is not required when TTHMs are the only analytes), EPA Method 524.2 (purge and trap, GC/MS), and EPA Method 551.1 (liquid-liquid extraction, GC/ECD), or an alternative method listed in appendix A to subpart C

conditions: Every system monitoring under subpart L, subpart U or subpart V (141.131(a)(1)); subpart L reaches community and nontransient noncommunity systems that add a chemical disinfectant, and transient noncommunity systems that use chlorine dioxide, for the chlorine dioxide MRDL (141.130(a)(2))

claims.subject: Approved methods for HAA5 compliance monitoring
claims.value: Standard Method 6251 B (liquid-liquid extraction with diazomethane, GC/ECD; also 6251 B-94 online), EPA Method 552.1 (solid phase extraction with acidic methanol, GC/ECD), and EPA Methods 552.2 and 552.3 (liquid-liquid extraction with acidic methanol, GC/ECD), or an alternative method listed in appendix A to subpart C
conditions: Samples for the 6251 B and 552.1 methods must be extracted within 14 days of collection (table note 5)

Every system monitoring under subpart L, subpart U or subpart V (141.131(a)(1)); subpart L reaches community and nontransient noncommunity systems that add a chemical disinfectant, and transient noncommunity systems that use chlorine dioxide, for the chlorine dioxide MRDL (141.130(a)(2))

claims.subject: Approved methods for bromate compliance monitoring
claims.value: Ion chromatography by EPA Method 300.1 or ASTM D 6581-00; ion chromatography with post-column reaction by EPA Methods 317.0 Revision 2.0 and 326.0; and IC/ICP-MS by EPA Method 321.8 (samples preserved with 50 mg ethylenediamine per liter and analyzed within 28 days), or an alternative method listed in appendix A to subpart C
conditions: Ion chromatography with post-column reaction or IC/ICP-MS must be used for bromate monitoring that demonstrates eligibility for reduced monitoring under 141.132(b)(3)(ii) (table note 6)

Every system monitoring under subpart L, subpart U or subpart V (141.131(a)(1)); subpart L reaches community and nontransient noncommunity systems that add a chemical disinfectant, and transient noncommunity systems that use chlorine dioxide, for the chlorine dioxide MRDL (141.130(a)(2))

claims.subject: Approved methods for chlorite compliance monitoring
claims.value: Amperometric titration (Standard Method 4500-ClO2 E or 4500-ClO2 E-00), spectrophotometry (EPA Method 327.0 Revision 1.1), and ion chromatography (EPA Methods 300.0, 300.1, 317.0 Revision 2.0, 326.0, or ASTM D 6581-00), or an alternative method listed in appendix A to subpart C
conditions: Amperometric titration or spectrophotometry may be used for the routine daily chlorite sample at the entrance to the distribution system; ion chromatography must be used for the routine monthly and additional distribution system chlorite monitoring (table note 8)

Every system monitoring under subpart L, subpart U or subpart V (141.131(a)(1)); subpart L reaches community and nontransient noncommunity systems that add a chemical disinfectant, and transient noncommunity systems that use chlorine dioxide, for the chlorine dioxide MRDL (141.130(a)(2))

claims.subject: Who may analyze disinfection byproduct samples
claims.value: Laboratories certified by EPA or the State, except as 141.131(b)(3) provides; certification for the DBP contaminants of 141.64, 141.135 and subparts U and V requires analyzing acceptable Performance Evaluation samples at least once in each consecutive 12-month period for each method

conditions: Every system monitoring under subpart L, subpart U or subpart V (141.131(a)(1)); subpart L reaches community and nontransient noncommunity systems that add a chemical disinfectant, and transient noncommunity systems that use chlorine dioxide, for the chlorine dioxide MRDL (141.130(a)(2))

claims.subject: Minimum reporting levels for DBP compliance data
claims.value: Since April 1, 2007, laboratories report quantitative data at least as low as: each of the four trihalomethanes 0.0010 mg/L; monochloroacetic acid 0.0020 mg/L and the other four haloacetic acids 0.0010 mg/L; chlorite 0.020 mg/L for the distribution system monitoring of 141.132(b)(2); bromate 0.0050 mg/L, or 0.0010 mg/L for laboratories using EPA Methods 317.0 Revision 2.0, 326.0 or 321.8

conditions: Every system monitoring under subpart L, subpart U or subpart V (141.131(a)(1)); subpart L reaches community and nontransient noncommunity systems that add a chemical disinfectant, and transient noncommunity systems that use chlorine dioxide, for the chlorine dioxide MRDL (141.130(a)(2))

claims.subject: Approved methods for chlorine, chloramine and chlorine dioxide residual measurement
claims.value: Amperometric titration (SM 4500-Cl D, ASTM D 1253), low level amperometric titration (4500-Cl E), DPD ferrous titrimetric (4500-Cl F), DPD colorimetric (4500-Cl G), syringaldazine FACTS (4500-Cl H) and iodometric electrode (4500-Cl I) for free, combined or total chlorine as the table marks; DPD (4500-ClO2 D), amperometric method II (4500-ClO2 E) and lissamine green spectrophotometric (EPA 327.0 Revision 1.1) for chlorine dioxide, or an alternative method listed in appendix A to subpart C
conditions: Free chlorine or total chlorine may be measured to demonstrate compliance with the chlorine MRDL; combined chlorine or total chlorine for the chloramine MRDL (table note 1)
The table marks which residual each method is approved for; this claim names the methods and defers to the table for the marks

Every system monitoring under subpart L, subpart U or subpart V (141.131(a)(1)); subpart L reaches community and nontransient noncommunity systems that add a chemical disinfectant, and transient noncommunity systems that use chlorine dioxide, for the chlorine dioxide MRDL (141.130(a)(2))

claims.subject: DPD colorimetric test kits and who may measure residuals
claims.value: If the State approves, systems may measure chlorine, chloramine and chlorine dioxide residuals with DPD colorimetric test kits; a party approved by EPA or the State must measure residual disinfectant concentration

conditions: Every system monitoring under subpart L, subpart U or subpart V (141.131(a)(1)); subpart L reaches community and nontransient noncommunity systems that add a chemical disinfectant, and transient noncommunity systems that use chlorine dioxide, for the chlorine dioxide MRDL (141.130(a)(2))

claims.subject: Approved methods for alkalinity, bromide and total organic carbon
claims.value: Alkalinity by any method allowed in 141.89(a); bromide by EPA Methods 300.0, 300.1, 317.0 Revision 2.0, 326.0 or ASTM D 6581-00; TOC by Standard Methods 5310 B, 5310 C or 5310 D (and their online versions) or EPA Method 415.3 Revision 1.1, with inorganic carbon removed, no filtration, acidification at collection to pH 2 or below, and analysis within 28 days; measured by a party approved by EPA or the State

conditions: Every system monitoring under subpart L, subpart U or subpart V (141.131(a)(1)); subpart L reaches community and nontransient noncommunity systems that add a chemical disinfectant, and transient noncommunity systems that use chlorine dioxide, for the chlorine dioxide MRDL (141.130(a)(2))

claims.subject: How specific ultraviolet absorbance (SUVA) is determined
claims.value: SUVA is the UV absorption at 254 nm (in inverse meters) divided by the dissolved organic carbon concentration (in mg/L), from UV254 and DOC measured separately by the methods in 141.131(d)(4)(i)-(ii) on water before the system adds any disinfectant or oxidant, with the DOC and UV254 samples taken at the same time and location

conditions: Every system monitoring under subpart L, subpart U or subpart V (141.131(a)(1)); subpart L reaches community and nontransient noncommunity systems that add a chemical disinfectant, and transient noncommunity systems that use chlorine dioxide, for the chlorine dioxide MRDL (141.130(a)(2))

claims.subject: Approved methods for pH and magnesium
claims.value: Any method allowed in 141.23(k)(1) for pH and for magnesium
